request.prompt:
Create ONE exceptionally well-crafted pixel-art room background for a finished cozy indie game. One complete room fills the entire opaque 1536x1024 canvas. NOT a collage, atlas, split screen or contact sheet. No characters, people, cats, flying food, UI, letters, numbers, logos or borders.

This is a higher-quality remake of a cozy pastel game room, preserving its layout and mood but replacing blurry, noisy, washed-out illustration with confident, deliberate PIXEL ART. Target the craftsmanship of premium modern pixel-art adventure games: clean contiguous pixel clusters, sharply defined stepped contours, readable silhouettes, carefully constructed material shading, subtle reflected light, controlled local contrast. Every object must be clear and attractive when downsampled to 640x360 and then integer-upscaled on a large monitor. A full 640x360 logical-pixel scene, NOT 320x180 and NOT a tiny retro thumbnail. Use fine purposeful details, not coarse blocky blobs. Render the pixel clusters SHARP, with no blur or soft brush texture. No film grain, speckles, random dithering, haze, chalkiness, watercolor, painterly strokes, JPEG artifacts or dirty patina. Large wall areas should be clean, quiet flat colors. Restrained high-quality pixel art, not a filtered photograph or a pixelated painting.

Use harmonious muted pastel colors as specified below, but keep enough local tonal separation to clearly distinguish curtains, window frames, wood trim, furniture cushions and individual leaves. Rich material ramps, typically 4-6 clear shades per material. Do not reduce the entire scene to 8 or 24 similar colors. No dark black outlines; outline furniture with a related muted shade. Backgrounds should be quieter and lighter than the game's strongly outlined cat and orange nuggets. Preserve a broad uncluttered central play area. The visual interest is primarily on side walls, inside the window, and along the lower edge. No dramatic shafts of light or bright glowing bloom.

Straight-on 2D camera, looking directly at the back wall, with a shallow floor strip along the bottom. No isometric perspective, no dollhouse view. Plan for a wide 16:9 final game frame: do not use tall narrow furniture, and leave the upper 15 percent of the picture quiet (a HUD will cover it). Whole room inside frame, objects arranged close to the supplied description. Aim for clean elegant architecture, detailed coherent decor, and warm lived-in charm. The final composition will be resized to 640x360: make small decor read at that size.


ROOM: SAGE KITCHEN. A cozy sage kitchen seen straight on. Almost symmetrical central four-pane window with cream-painted wood frame, dusty peach linen curtains tied back, a calm pastel garden visible outside. Left shelf holds three distinct lidded ceramic jars with simple leaf decorations; a small framed botanical picture beneath it. Right shelf has a leafy potted herb and a cream mug. Pale sage tiled backsplash with restrained thin seams. A long cream countertop across the lower third, over neatly crafted sage cabinet doors and drawers with small muted brass handles. Cream-and-peach striped dish towel at far right. Preserve open uncluttered countertop and wall areas, no additional clutter. Cabinet joinery, curtain pleats, ceramics and plant leaves should be rendered with precise intentional pixel shapes. Soft daylight.
Palette anchors: wall #cedbca, tile seams #bdcebb, cabinets #adb8a0, shadows #859886, trim #f2e6cd, sky #b8d7d5, garden #9bb9a5, curtains #d5b8a1. Use tasteful related shades to retain definition and material detail. Maintain the pastel sage and linen color identity.
